MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which initial is said with a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. p
   B. f
   C. m
   D. b

2. What does 哥哥 (gēge) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is, am, are
   B. Daughter
   C. Love
   D. Older brother

3. Which two words are said with a tone followed by a light syllable? (1 mark)
   A. nǐ and hǎo
   B. dà and xiǎo
   C. bàba and gēge
   D. wǒ and nǐ

4. What does 谁 (shéi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older brother
   B. Who
   C. Younger sister
   D. Love

5. Read the pinyin: wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. We cut the cake.
   C. My birthday is on 5 March.
   D. We sing.

6. Which sentence means "My birthday is on 5 March."? (1 mark)
   A. 我的生日是三月五号。
   B. 朋友送我礼物。
   C. 我们切蛋糕。
   D. 你生日是几月几号?

7. Which Chinese word means "spinach"? (1 mark)
   A. 菠菜 bōcài
   B. 水果 shuǐguǒ
   C. 水 shuǐ
   D. 米饭 mǐfàn

8. Read the pinyin: wǒ hē chá. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like to eat bananas.
   B. This is a banana.
   C. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   D. I drink tea.

9. Which sentence means "What is this?"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是什么?
   B. 我喜欢吃香蕉。
   C. 我早饭吃饼。
   D. 这是香蕉。

10. In the song 头、肩膀、膝盖、脚, which word is a joint in the leg? (1 mark)
   A. 膝盖
   B. 脚
   C. 肩膀
   D. 头

11. Which is an extreme weather event? (1 mark)
   A. 云 a cloud
   B. 太阳 the sun
   C. 风 a light breeze
   D. 洪水 a flood

12. Which sentence do we use to name a weather picture? (1 mark)
   A. 你好太阳。
   B. 我叫太阳。
   C. 太阳在哪儿?
   D. 这是太阳。

13. What does 前面 (qiánmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Table
   B. Door
   C. In front of
   D. Television

14. Fill the blank: 这是____? (Who is this?) (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 哪儿
   C. 几
   D. 谁

15. What does 我爱你 wǒ ài nǐ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I love you
   B. I am you
   C. I like you
   D. I see you

16. Which sentence means "This is my older sister."? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我弟弟。
   B. 这是我爸爸。
   C. 我爱你。
   D. 这是我姐姐。

17. What does 房间 (fángjiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Left side
   B. Where
   C. Beside
   D. Room

18. What does 星期三 (xīngqīsān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. Wednesday
   C. One
   D. Today

19. What does 蔬菜 (shūcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Vegetables
   B. Mango
   C. Lunch
   D. Chicken (meat)

20. What does 牛奶 niúnǎi mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tea
   B. Beef
   C. Milk
   D. Chicken

21. Which word means "snacks"? (1 mark)
   A. 饮料
   B. 水果
   C. 蔬菜
   D. 零食

22. What does 两 (liǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nose
   B. Foot
   C. Tooth
   D. Two (before a counting word)

23. In the character 人, which stroke is written first? (1 mark)
   A. 竖 shù
   B. 捺 nà
   C. 点 diǎn
   D. 撇 piě

24. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello! (polite)
   B. Hello!
   C. Good morning!
   D. My name is Xiaoming.

25. How many strokes does the character 大 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 2
   D. 3

26. What does 我家有五口人 mean? (1 mark)
   A. My house has five rooms
   B. There are five people in my family
   C. I am five years old
   D. I have five brothers

27. Which sentence means "This is my father."? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我哥哥。
   B. 这是我爸爸。
   C. 那是我弟弟。
   D. 我家有五口人。

28. What does 客厅 (kètīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is at, is in
   B. Living room
   C. Cat
   D. Where

29. Which word is pronounced wòshì? (1 mark)
   A. 床
   B. 里
   C. 卧室
   D. 门

30. Read the pinyin: wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday I rest at home.
   B. On Wednesday I go to school.
   C. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   D. Today is Wednesday.

31. What does 快乐 (kuàilè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Birthday
   B. Happy
   C. Plate
   D. Cake

32. Which sentence is written on a birthday card? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 祝你生日快乐!
   C. 再见!
   D. 你好吗?

33. What does 水 (shuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To eat
   B. Water
   C. Beef
   D. Vegetables

34. What does 什么 (shénme) mean? (1 mark)
   A. What
   B. Snacks
   C. Meat
   D. Fruit (as a group)

35. What does 听 (tīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To listen, to hear
   B. Two (before a counting word)
   C. Shoulder
   D. To brush teeth

36. Which sentence means "I have two eyes."? (1 mark)
   A. 我有两只眼睛。
   B. 我用耳朵听。
   C. 我用嘴巴说。
   D. 我用眼睛看。

37. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my ears to hear.
   B. I use my mouth to speak.
   C. I use my eyes to see.
   D. I have two eyes.

38. What does 天 (tiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Snow
   B. Sky, day
   C. Rain
   D. Drought

39. Which Chinese word means "it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 下雨 xià yǔ
   B. 天 tiān
   C. 刮风 guā fēng
   D. 太阳 tàiyáng

40. Which Chinese word means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. 桌子 zhuōzi
   B. 花园 huāyuán
   C. 房子 fángzi
   D. 下 xià

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Add punctuation to: 我喜欢芒果香蕉葡萄你呢 (3 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very light." (2 marks)

43. Write a dialogue of five lines in Chinese with pinyin between two learners about a food picture: ask what it is, answer, ask if they like it, and reply. (5 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The fridge is in the kitchen." (2 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 上面, 周 and 同学们. (3 marks)

46. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 盘子, 爱 and 唱歌. (3 marks)

47. Write the difference in meaning between chuáng and chuāng. (2 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I have two eyes." (3 marks)

49. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

50. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 礼物 and 冰箱. (2 marks)

51. Give two habits for keeping your body clean. (2 marks)

52. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello, teacher!" (2 marks)

53. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my ears to hear." (2 marks)

54. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒmen qiē dàngāo. (2 marks)

55. Give two words with the final -ao and one with the final -ang, with pinyin. (3 marks)

56. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" (3 marks)

57. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The weather is very good today." (3 marks)

58. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛奶, 大 and 昨天. (3 marks)

59. Put these words in order and translate: 在 / 电视 / 上 / 桌子. (3 marks)

60. Draw a plan of a home with a garden, door, window and sofa and write four sentences about where things are, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

61. Explain the difference between skimming and scanning. (2 marks)

62. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肩膀, 切 and 去. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — p
   p has a puff of air, while b does not.

2. D — Older brother
   哥哥 (gēge) means older brother.

3. C — bàba and gēge
   The second syllable of bàba and gēge is neutral.

4. B — Who
   谁 (shéi) means who.

5. C — My birthday is on 5 March.
   wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào. is 我的生日是三月五号。, which means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

6. A — 我的生日是三月五号。
   我的生日是三月五号。 (wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.) means "My birthday is on 5 March.".

7. A — 菠菜 bōcài
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

8. D — I drink tea.
   wǒ hē chá. is 我喝茶。, which means "I drink tea.".

9. A — 这是什么?
   这是什么? (zhè shì shénme?) means "What is this?".

10. A — 膝盖
   膝盖 is the knee.

11. D — 洪水 a flood
   洪水 hóngshuǐ is a flood.

12. D — 这是太阳。
   这是 + word names what we see.

13. C — In front of
   前面 (qiánmiàn) means in front of.

14. D — 谁
   谁 means who.

15. A — I love you
   爱 is love.

16. D — 这是我姐姐。
   这是我姐姐。 (zhè shì wǒ jiějie.) means "This is my older sister.".

17. D — Room
   房间 (fángjiān) means room.

18. B — Wednesday
   星期三 (xīngqīsān) means Wednesday.

19. A — Vegetables
   蔬菜 (shūcài) means vegetables.

20. C — Milk
   牛奶 is milk; 牛肉 is beef.

21. D — 零食
   零食 língshí is snacks.

22. D — Two (before a counting word)
   两 (liǎng) means two (before a counting word).

23. D — 撇 piě
   撇 before 捺.

24. D — My name is Xiaoming.
   wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. is 我叫小明。, which means "My name is Xiaoming.".

25. D — 3
   大 has 横, 撇 and 捺.

26. B — There are five people in my family
   五口人 is five people.

27. B — 这是我爸爸。
   这是我爸爸。 (zhè shì wǒ bàba.) means "This is my father.".

28. B — Living room
   客厅 (kètīng) means living room.

29. C — 卧室
   卧室 is pronounced wòshì and means bedroom.

30. A — On Saturday I rest at home.
   wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. is 我星期六在家休息。, which means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

31. B — Happy
   快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

32. B — 祝你生日快乐!
   祝你生日快乐 is happy birthday to you.

33. B — Water
   水 (shuǐ) means water.

34. A — What
   什么 (shénme) means what.

35. A — To listen, to hear
   听 (tīng) means to listen, to hear.

36. A — 我有两只眼睛。
   我有两只眼睛。 (wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.) means "I have two eyes.".

37. B — I use my mouth to speak.
   wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. is 我用嘴巴说。, which means "I use my mouth to speak.".

38. B — Sky, day
   天 (tiān) means sky, day.

39. A — 下雨 xià yǔ
   下雨 (xià yǔ) means it rains.

40. B — 花园 huāyuán
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢芒果、香蕉、葡萄。你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 、, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for ?.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很小。 fēng hěn xiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? B: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo. A: 你喜欢吃香蕉吗? nǐ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo ma? B: 我喜欢。 wǒ xǐhuan. A: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line with pinyin.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 冰箱在厨房。 bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: 上面: shàngmiàn, above. 周: zhōu, week (short form). 同学们: tóngxuémen, classmates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: 盘子: pánzi, plate. 爱: ài, love. 唱歌: chànggē, to sing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: chuáng 床 is a bed and chuāng 窗 is a window. The tones are different.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我有两只眼睛。 wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 礼物: lǐwù, gift. 冰箱: bīngxiāng, fridge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash your hands with soap (洗手), brush your teeth (刷牙), bathe often, wear clean clothes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: 老师好! lǎoshī hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: We cut the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 好 hǎo, 小 xiǎo; 房 fáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: 今天天气很好。 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: 牛奶: niúnǎi, milk. 大: dà, big. 昨天: zuótiān, yesterday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。and pinyin optional, 1 mark for the meaning.

60. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example 门在左边。 mén zài zuǒbian. 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn. 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the plan and 1 mark for each correct sentence.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Scanning is looking for one particular word or fact.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肩膀: jiānbǎng, shoulder. 切: qiē, to cut. 去: qù, to go.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
